pricing.notes: Resident/nonresident status, delivery and program change tuition. No individual degree price was verified in this review.

institutional.notes: Official 2025 guaranteed-admission transfer agreement allows up to 90 transfer credits under that agreement; this is not asserted as an unconditional schoolwide cap. Degree requirements and academic residence still apply.
institutional.applicability: The cited 2025 guaranteed-admission transfer agreement; verify eligibility and individual program audit.

ace.notes: This review did not verify that Sophia, Study.com or other ACE-recommended noncollege courses are accepted. Exam credit and institutional transfer are separate evaluations.

graduate.notes: Undergraduate agreement limits do not establish graduate transfer limits.
